description: This file contains utility functions for managing chat session labels and filtering recent chat sessions for the Android app UI, including deriving human-readable session names and selecting recent sessions based on timestamps.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents a chat session entry with key and optional last updated timestamp.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable label from a session key, normalizing common prefixes and formatting.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Filters and sorts chat sessions to produce a list of recent and main sessions based on timestamps and current context.
